source_refs.note: Topic 6.4.2 (PDF 163-164, printed 160-161). MCQ 4 is answered (c); the key gives (b). MCQ 7 is answered (b); the key gives (c). Recorded.

items: Cryptocurrencies: blockchain underlies Bitcoin and Ethereum, enabling decentralized digital transactions without intermediaries.
Supply chain management: tracking and verifying goods to prevent fraud and errors and prove authenticity.
Healthcare: storing patient records securely so only authorized people can see them.
Voting systems: recording and counting votes accurately and transparently to reduce election fraud.

blocks.text: Blockchain is often compared to a digital ledger that everyone in the network can see and agree on; once a page is added it cannot be changed (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: What is a key advantage of a distributed ledger (MCQ 4)? What is its purpose (MCQ 7)?
blocks.explanation: (c) enhanced transparency and security due to decentralized verification; (b) to let many participants share and verify data securely and transparently.

items: Uses: cryptocurrency, supply chains, healthcare records, voting.
